description: Set owner W-2 comp at a defensible benchmark to balance payroll tax savings against QBI wage limits and retirement plan contribution room
trigger_conditions: entity_type = S-Corp; owner W-2 comp deviates >15% from role/revenue benchmark; OR comp-to-distribution ratio out of line with industry norms
savings_heuristic: (benchmark comp − current comp) × 15.3% FICA (up to wage base; 2.9%–3.8% Medicare above); offset against QBI wage-limit and retirement-contribution effects — model both directions
authority_reference: IRC §3121(d)(1); Rev. Rul. 74-44; Watson v. Comm'r (8th Cir. 2012)
economic_substance_notes: Written comp study using salary benchmarks (RCReports or similar); board minutes documenting comp decision; consistent payroll filings

description: Elect entity-level state tax so state taxes become a federal deduction, bypassing the individual SALT cap
trigger_conditions: pass-through entity in a PTE-election state (e.g., CA); profitable; owners' SALT deduction capped or phased down at their income level
savings_heuristic: state PTE tax paid × owner federal marginal rate (e.g., CA 9.3% PTE × 37% ≈ 3.4% of qualified income); verify benefit vs current-law SALT cap at owner's income
authority_reference: IRC §164; IRS Notice 2020-75; CA AB 150 / RTC §19900
economic_substance_notes: Timely election on entity return; meet state prepayment deadlines (CA: June 15 prepay for continuing elections); consent of owners

description: Change entity classification when profit level, reinvestment profile, or exit plans favor a different structure
trigger_conditions: profit crossing entity break-even thresholds; QBI deduction phased out; heavy reinvestment (favors C) or high distributions (favors S); QSBS exit potential
savings_heuristic: full comparative model: 21% flat C rate + dividend layer vs individual rates + QBI; include state entity taxes and exit taxation
economic_substance_notes: Board resolutions; Form 2553 or revocation filings; BIG-tax exposure analysis before S→C→S moves; 5-year commitment mindset

description: Separate functions (management, IP, real estate) into related entities for payroll-tax, liability, and state arbitrage benefits
trigger_conditions: multiple active businesses; owner performing distinct management functions; real estate used by operating business; state nexus differences
savings_heuristic: varies — model payroll-tax delta, QBI aggregation effects, and state rate arbitrage on arm's-length management fees
authority_reference: IRC §482 (related-party pricing); §162 (ordinary & necessary); management-fee case law
economic_substance_notes: Written management agreements; arm's-length fee studies; actual services actually performed and documented; separate books/bank accounts

description: Use a non-calendar fiscal year to defer income between the corporation and calendar-year owners
trigger_conditions: new or converting C-Corp; seasonal income concentration; owner bonus timing flexibility desired
savings_heuristic: one-time deferral ≈ deferred income × marginal rate × months deferred ÷ 12 (time-value benefit, recurring at margin)
economic_substance_notes: Adopt on first return or via Form 1128; consistent application; bonus accruals must satisfy §267 related-party timing

description: Structure C-Corp stock to qualify for exclusion of gain on sale after the holding period
trigger_conditions: C-Corp (or conversion candidate); qualified trade (not services/finance/hospitality); aggregate gross assets under the §1202 cap at issuance; exit horizon ≥ 3–5 yrs
savings_heuristic: excluded gain × ~23.8% (LTCG+NIIT); current-law caps and tiered holding periods apply to post-7/4/2025 issuances (OBBBA enhancements) — verify vintage rules
economic_substance_notes: Issuance-date asset test documentation; original-issuance requirement; qualified-business activity records; track holding period per share lot

description: Qualify corporate stock so a future loss is ordinary (up to $50k / $100k MFJ per year) instead of capital
trigger_conditions: corporation capitalized ≤ $1M at issuance; stock issued for money/property to individuals; loss risk exists
savings_heuristic: up to $100k MFJ × (ordinary marginal rate − capital loss value, often limited to $3k/yr) in a loss year
economic_substance_notes: Plan documentation at issuance; capitalization records; stock issued directly (not purchased from another holder)

description: Max owner-only retirement contributions; choose the vehicle that allows the largest deferral at the client's income
trigger_conditions: self-employed or owner-only entity; profit supports contributions; current deferrals below current-year limits
savings_heuristic: additional contribution × marginal rate (federal + state); Solo 401(k) usually beats SEP below ~$330k comp due to the employee deferral layer
economic_substance_notes: Plan adopted by applicable deadline; W-2 comp supports contribution (S-Corp); Form 5500-EZ when assets > $250k

description: Add an actuarially-driven plan enabling six-figure deductible contributions for older high-income owners
trigger_conditions: owner age ≥ ~45; stable income ≥ ~$400k; few or no non-owner employees (or willing to fund required staff contributions); 3+ year commitment horizon
savings_heuristic: contribution ($100k–$300k+ actuarially determined) × marginal rate, net of required staff cost
economic_substance_notes: Actuary engagement; formal plan document; minimum-funding obligations are real commitments; combine with 401(k) per deduction-limit rules

description: After-tax 401(k) contributions converted in-plan to Roth, far above normal Roth limits
trigger_conditions: 401(k) plan permits after-tax contributions AND in-service conversions/rollovers; owner has savings capacity beyond elective deferral limits
savings_heuristic: (415(c) limit − deferrals − match) converted annually; benefit = NPV of tax-free growth on the converted layer
economic_substance_notes: Plan document must permit both features (solo plans: amend); convert promptly to minimize taxable earnings; track basis on Form 8606 where applicable

description: Nondeductible traditional IRA contribution followed by Roth conversion for taxpayers above Roth income limits
trigger_conditions: MAGI above Roth contribution limits; little or no pre-tax IRA balances (pro-rata rule); annual habit candidate
savings_heuristic: annual limit per spouse × NPV of tax-free growth; near-zero current-year cost if no pre-tax IRA balances
economic_substance_notes: File Form 8606 each year; check aggregate IRA balances every year before converting; consider rolling pre-tax IRAs into employer plan first

description: Convert pre-tax balances to Roth in unusually low-income years to lock in low brackets
trigger_conditions: projected low-bracket year (business loss, NOL, gap year, retirement pre-RMD); funds available to pay conversion tax outside the IRA
savings_heuristic: converted amount × (expected future marginal rate − current conversion rate); ladder across years to fill target brackets
economic_substance_notes: Model bracket fill precisely before year-end; conversions are irrevocable (no recharacterization); watch IRMAA and credit phase-outs

description: Engineering study reclassifies building components to 5/7/15-year property eligible for bonus depreciation
trigger_conditions: building/improvements basis ≥ ~$500k (excluding land); placed in service; owner can absorb losses (material participation, REPS, STR, or closely-held C-Corp offset)
savings_heuristic: typically 20–35% of building basis reclassified × 100% bonus (current law for post-1/19/2025 acquisitions) × marginal rate — mostly a timing benefit; quantify NPV
authority_reference: IRC §168(k) (as amended by OBBBA 2025); §§1245/1250; Hospital Corp. of America v. Comm'r
economic_substance_notes: Engineering-based study by qualified provider; recapture planning on exit; passive-loss usability MUST be confirmed before promising benefit

description: Qualify a spouse as a real estate professional so rental losses offset active income
trigger_conditions: rental losses present or planned (esp. w/ cost seg); one spouse with 750+ hrs/yr in real property trades AND more than half their personal-service time; contemporaneous logs feasible
savings_heuristic: unlocked rental losses × marginal rate in year(s) claimed
economic_substance_notes: CONTEMPORANEOUS time logs are non-negotiable (audit-prone); material participation in each rental or valid grouping election; W-2 full-time job usually disqualifies that spouse

description: STRs with average stay ≤ 7 days are non-passive with material participation — losses offset active income without REPS
trigger_conditions: property rented short-term (avg guest stay ≤ 7 days); owner materially participates (100+ hrs & more than anyone else, or 500 hrs); cost seg planned
savings_heuristic: rental loss (often bonus-driven) × marginal rate — without needing REPS qualification
economic_substance_notes: Guest-stay records proving ≤7-day average; participation hour logs; self-management or documented co-management; substantial services may trigger SE tax — review

description: Defer gain on investment real estate by exchanging into replacement property
trigger_conditions: appreciated investment/business real property sale contemplated; willing to acquire replacement real estate; timeline workable
savings_heuristic: deferred gain × (23.8% LTCG/NIIT + state) — deferral NPV; potential basis step-up at death eliminates permanently
economic_substance_notes: Qualified intermediary engaged BEFORE closing; strict deadlines; like-kind real property only; document identification in writing

description: Roll capital gains into a QOF to defer gain and eliminate tax on fund appreciation after 10 years
trigger_conditions: large realized capital gain within 180 days; 10+ year horizon; suitable QOF/deal available
savings_heuristic: deferral on rolled gain + 100% exclusion of QOF appreciation after 10 yrs; current-law (OBBBA permanent OZ) basis-step rules apply
economic_substance_notes: 180-day reinvestment window; QOF/QOZB compliance testing; substantial-improvement rules for property deals; long illiquidity — suitability matters

description: Business rents owner's home ≤14 days/year; rent is deductible to the business and tax-free to the owner
trigger_conditions: business owner with personal residence; legitimate business meetings/events (board, planning, trainings); ≤14 rental days/yr
savings_heuristic: days (≤14) × defensible local daily rate × marginal rate
authority_reference: IRC §280A(g); Sinopoli v. Comm'r (T.C. Memo 2023-105) — rate discipline
economic_substance_notes: Comparable venue rate quotes retained; meeting minutes/agendas for each date; corporate resolution; invoice + actual payment; post-Sinopoli, modest defensible rates only

description: Group activities as one economic unit so combined hours achieve material participation
trigger_conditions: multiple related activities (e.g., operating business + leased building; several rentals) where separate testing fails but combined passes
savings_heuristic: previously-suspended or current passive losses unlocked × marginal rate
economic_substance_notes: Written grouping statement filed with return; groupings are sticky (can't regroup freely); appropriate-economic-unit facts documented

description: A closely-held C-Corp (not a PSC) may offset passive losses against net active income — unavailable to individuals without REPS
trigger_conditions: closely-held C-Corp with net active income; passive losses available or plannable (e.g., real estate + cost seg inside/under the C-Corp); corporation is NOT a personal service corporation
savings_heuristic: passive loss absorbed × 21% federal (+ state corporate rate)
economic_substance_notes: Confirm non-PSC status (e.g., insurance agency OK; law/accounting PSC not); ownership tests for closely-held; double-tax exit planning for appreciating real estate (consider S-election + 5-yr wait per §1374)

description: Pay minor children reasonable wages for real work; wages land in their 0% bracket and may be FICA-exempt
trigger_conditions: owner with children (best under 18); business is sole prop or parents-only partnership for FICA exemption (or family mgmt co); legitimate age-appropriate work exists
savings_heuristic: wage up to child's standard deduction × parent marginal rate + 15.3% FICA saved where exempt; funds can seed child Roth IRA
economic_substance_notes: Real duties + timesheets; reasonable hourly rate; payroll processed with W-2; child's own bank account; corporate employers lose FICA exemption (consider family management company)

description: Shift income-producing assets to lower-bracket family members within kiddie-tax limits
trigger_conditions: lower-bracket family members (adult children, parents); income-producing assets giftable; kiddie tax limits understood for minors/students
savings_heuristic: shifted income × bracket differential; minors capped by kiddie-tax unearned-income threshold
authority_reference: IRC §1(g) (kiddie tax); §102; gift tax annual exclusion
economic_substance_notes: Complete real transfers (no strings); gift tax returns where required; kiddie tax applies through age 23 for students — model first

description: Front-load five years of gift-tax annual exclusions into a 529 in one year
trigger_conditions: education-bound children/grandchildren; gifting capacity; state deduction availability a plus
savings_heuristic: state deduction (where offered) × state rate + tax-free growth NPV; 5× annual exclusion per donor per beneficiary at once
economic_substance_notes: File Form 709 electing 5-year spread; no additional gifts to that beneficiary during spread period; confirm state deduction caps/recapture

description: Corporation reimburses owner's business-use-of-home and out-of-pocket costs — deductible to the entity, tax-free to the owner
trigger_conditions: S-Corp or C-Corp owner paying business costs personally (home office, mileage, phone, internet); no accountable plan on file
savings_heuristic: annual reimbursable costs (often $3k–$10k) × marginal rate; also removes these from owner's taxable income entirely
authority_reference: Treas. Reg. §1.62-2; IRC §280A(c) methodology for home-office math
economic_substance_notes: Written accountable-plan document; monthly/quarterly expense reports with substantiation; reimburse actual amounts (no flat allowances)

description: Employer-funded health reimbursement arrangement makes medical premiums/costs a business deduction
trigger_conditions: small employer without group plan (ICHRA) OR C-Corp owner-employee; QSEHRA for <50 employees as alternative
savings_heuristic: reimbursed premiums + medical costs × (marginal rate + payroll-tax effects); compare vs self-employed health insurance deduction baseline
economic_substance_notes: Formal plan documents; ACA-compliant individual coverage for ICHRA participants; nondiscrimination rules; S-Corp >2% shareholders have special W-2 treatment — route correctly

description: Max HSA contributions for the only triple-tax-advantaged account available
trigger_conditions: HDHP-covered client; HSA contributions below current-year family/self limits; catch-up at 55+
savings_heuristic: unfunded gap × (marginal rate + 7.65% FICA if via cafeteria plan); invest balance for tax-free medical growth
economic_substance_notes: HDHP status verified each year; contribution routed through payroll where possible for FICA savings; keep receipts for future reimbursement strategy

description: Sole proprietor employs spouse; family medical costs become fully deductible business expenses via employee benefit
trigger_conditions: Schedule C/F business; spouse performs bona fide work as employee; family has meaningful out-of-pocket medical costs
savings_heuristic: family medical costs shifted from itemized-floor limbo to 100% business deduction × (income + SE tax rates)
authority_reference: IRC §105(b); Rev. Rul. 71-588; Speltz guidance line
economic_substance_notes: Bona fide employment (duties, hours, W-2, reasonable wage); written §105 plan covering employee+family; audit-sensitive — documentation discipline required

description: Credit for qualified research wages/supplies/contract research; payroll-tax offset for eligible small businesses
trigger_conditions: software/product/process development activity meeting the §41 four-part test; W-2 technical wages; startups may offset payroll tax
savings_heuristic: ≈ 6–10% of qualified research expenses federal (+ state credits); startup payroll offset up to current-law cap
economic_substance_notes: Contemporaneous project documentation tying activities to the four-part test; nexus between wages and qualified activities; credible study provider

description: Federal credit for hiring from targeted groups (veterans, SNAP recipients, long-term unemployed, etc.)
trigger_conditions: active hiring; candidate pool likely includes targeted groups; onboarding process can absorb the screening form
savings_heuristic: $2,400–$9,600 per certified hire depending on category and hours
economic_substance_notes: Form 8850 signed on/before job offer and filed within 28 days of start; state workforce agency certification retained

description: Remaining building/vehicle/energy credits — several sunset under OBBBA, so screen against current-law availability dates
trigger_conditions: planned building efficiency work (§179D — check construction-start sunset); commercial clean vehicles (§45W availability); solar/storage projects (§48E phase-outs)
savings_heuristic: project-specific; confirm credit percentage AND current-law termination dates before quoting any savings
authority_reference: IRC §179D; §45W; §48E — all as amended by OBBBA 2025 (multiple sunsets)
economic_substance_notes: Placed-in-service and construction-start dates versus statutory deadlines are decisive; certification/energy-modeling requirements; document eligibility before the client commits

description: Concentrate several years of giving into one itemizing year via a DAF; grant to charities on the normal schedule
trigger_conditions: recurring annual giving near the standard-deduction breakeven; current-law 0.5%-of-AGI itemizer floor makes bunching MORE valuable from 2026
savings_heuristic: (bunched deduction − standard deduction years) × marginal rate, net of the current-law AGI floor haircut
economic_substance_notes: DAF sponsor paperwork; contribution timing before year-end; substantiation letters; avoid donor benefits that reduce deductibility

description: Donate long-term appreciated securities instead of cash — deduct FMV and never recognize the gain
trigger_conditions: charitable intent + appreciated LT positions in taxable accounts; giving already happening in cash
savings_heuristic: gain avoided × 23.8% + FMV deduction × marginal rate (subject to 30%-AGI limit with carryforward)
economic_substance_notes: Transfer securities in-kind (never sell first); LT holding period confirmed; qualified appraisal rules for non-publicly-traded assets

description: Split-interest trusts to defer/spread gain on appreciated assets while funding charitable intent and retained income
trigger_conditions: large appreciated asset (business, real estate, concentrated stock) + genuine charitable intent + income need (CRT) or estate/gift goals (CLT)
savings_heuristic: CRT: gain spread over payout years + partial deduction; model against outright sale — attorney-designed, case-by-case
economic_substance_notes: Specialist attorney drafting; 10% remainder test; trustee administration; irrevocable — client education essential before committing

description: Spread gain recognition over the note term when selling a business or property with seller financing
trigger_conditions: sale of business/property where buyer financing is negotiable; seller doesn't need full proceeds immediately; gain would spike brackets if lump-sum
savings_heuristic: bracket smoothing: Σ(gain in lower brackets vs single-year spike) + deferral NPV; watch §453A interest charge on obligations > $5M
economic_substance_notes: Note terms with adequate stated interest (AFR); security/default provisions; depreciation recapture recognized up front — model it; election out is available if rates favor

description: Systematically realize losses in taxable accounts to offset gains; direct indexing scales the opportunity
trigger_conditions: taxable brokerage with unrealized losses or concentrated low-basis positions; ongoing gains to offset
savings_heuristic: harvested losses × applicable gains rate + $3k/yr ordinary offset; carryforwards indefinite
economic_substance_notes: 30-day wash-sale discipline (both directions, all accounts incl. IRAs and spouse); replacement-security plan to maintain exposure

description: Accelerate or defer income and deductions around projected bracket swings, phase-outs, and law changes
trigger_conditions: projected marginal-rate swing between years (sale year, low year, retirement); controllable items exist (bonuses, invoicing, PTE payments, equipment purchases, Roth conversions)
savings_heuristic: Σ shifted items × rate differential between years; include phase-out cliffs (QBI, IRMAA, credits) in the model
economic_substance_notes: Two-year (minimum) projection model before year-end; document business purpose for timing moves; coordinate with estimated-payment safe harbors
